# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stands (iPhone, Apple Watch, AirPods)

**Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand**
- WIRED's top pick. It has a chrome stand, 15W Qi2 for the iPhone, and fast charging for Apple Watch Series 7 and newer.
- The iPhone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy. It comes with a 36W power supply and a 2-year warranty.
- WIRED lists it at $109, with sale prices of $90 at Amazon and $80 at Best Buy.
- I don't have a direct product link from the search results. WIRED's guide has the shop links: [WIRED's best 3-in-1 chargers](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station**
- WIRED calls it the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 it has found. It has a 15W magnetic pad, and a charger and cable are included.
- It was listed at $40 on Amazon (down from $80), but check the current price. The Apple Watch charger is a separate piece that slots into the back, and WIRED said it lost the cap right away.
- Buy via [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/).

**Fastest, if you have an iPhone 16 or 17: ESR CryoBoost (Qi2.2 25W)**
- It has 25W charging, active cooling with a fan you can switch off, a 50W adapter included, and a fold-flat design.
- 25W applies only to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. Other recent iPhones get 20W, and older ones get 15W.
- ESR's store price is $99.99, or about $82 with code PARTNER18. The site that tested the code says ESR's cart accepted it. Checkout has the final say.
- [Buy at ESR](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand). This is an affiliate link, so the retailer pays the site a commission. [Product details](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)

**Other good options**
- **Nomad Stand One Max ($169):** WIRED's fastest-charging pick at 25W, with a premium glossy build. It doesn't include a power adapter, and you need one rated at 40W. [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Qi2 25W ($129.99):** Macworld says it's the tallest and most adjustable foldable stand. It includes a 45W adapter with UK and EU plugs. [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)
- **Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2), about $80:** WIRED's best travel pick. It folds slim and charges at 15W. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)
- **Nimble Podium ($130):** A flat pad design that keeps screens out of sight at night. [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**My pick:** For most people, I'd get the Belkin. The extra speed of 25W models matters little if you charge overnight, as WIRED also notes. If you have an iPhone 16 or 17 and want fast charging, get the ESR CryoBoost or Satechi. If price is the priority, get the ESR 15W model.

Check that your AirPods case supports wireless charging, since the third pad won't work with older cases. Prices change, so confirm at checkout.
